name: Heights funicular station and track composition

approval.note: W0 design proposal only; not drawn, gated, approved or available for placement.

variants.note: Lower station with dry queue apron.
Upper station with cable wheel and route landing.

story.lore: Reserve the planned Heights shortcut as an engineered route with both stations, instead of dressing an unwalkable slope as stairs.

todo: Purpose: Reserve the planned Heights shortcut as an engineered route with both stations, instead of dressing an unwalkable slope as stairs.
Visual brief: Two small stone/iron stations embedded in terraces, rails following the actual fall line, a cable sheave over the top and visible supporting base where the line crosses a face.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 8x6 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Proposal status: the regional brief calls this a shortcut; implementation requires the owner’s route/transport contract.
Rule proposal: upper and lower track connectors meet a declared same-system line and each station’s route landing is on that station’s tier; never imply walking on track.
Uniqueness: station pair and track profile belong to the Heights; shared building/railing pieces can form the shell.
